verdict.rationale: Docs reference on-prem/self-hosted configuration ('configure-on-prem.md'), a hybrid architecture where the control plane stays out of the data path, and a quickstart script to spin up a demo instance, implying self-hosting is supported. However, there's no explicit statement of open-source licensing, no detailed self-host installation/deployment guide, and no independent corroboration of a fully self-hosted core product experience. Missing for 10: explicit open-source/self-host licensing terms, step-by-step self-hosted deployment docs, and third-party confirmation of running the core product without Konnect dependency.
